crime: Earlier that week, a girl in the lounge mended {WITCH_NAME}'s torn cuff and slipped an arm around her shoulders. Over the next few days, they worked on needlework together, and {WITCH_NAME} let the girl choose the thread.
Today, the girl returned their unfinished needlework to {WITCH_NAME} and told her to leave. Then she took up her sewing basket and began teaching another prisoner in {WITCH_NAME}'s place.

That evening, the girl apologized over tea and sat with her again. But {WITCH_NAME} had laced the tea they shared with a sleeping drug, leaving them both unconscious. While they slept, the garrote guided {WITCH_NAME}'s hands and strangled the girl.

Later that evening, the prisoners found the girl dead in the lounge and {WITCH_NAME} unresponsive, still gripping the garrote. It appeared that someone had drugged her and planted the weapon in her hands to frame her.

At the trial court, a prisoner examined a phone recording. Even as {WITCH_NAME} lay asleep, the cord in her hands was tightening. The moving cord showed that she had not been framed: the garrote had been controlling her as she slept.
fields.epitaph: Only at the end did she understand: being led was never the same as belonging.
execution: A crank chair on the execution stand clamps cuffs around the witch's wrists. The chair guides her bound hands to its crank and makes them turn; each rotation tightens the collar around her neck. Even when her hands go limp, the chair keeps cranking until she slumps into silence.

magic.name: Let the Tools Lead
magic.text: Tools and instruments guide your body, letting you use them with expert skill.
